notes.title: Controller Setup Guide for Optimal Gameplay
notes.content:
Controller Setup Guide for Optimal Gameplay
Dear players,
To enhance your experience with Gigantosaurus: Dino Sports, please note that the 'B' button on Xbox controllers and the 'O' button on PlayStation controllers may not function correctly if Steam Input is enabled. To fix this, please:
Open your Steam library and select "Gigantosaurus: Dino Sports".
Right-click and go to "Properties".
Head to the "Controller" tab.
Select "Disable Steam Input".
By adjusting these settings, your controllers should work perfectly in-game. Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

notes.title: 🚨 Announcement: Gigantosaurus: Dino Sports Multiplayer Feature! 🚨
notes.content:
Hey Dino fans!
We have some exciting news about our upcoming game, Gigantosaurus: Dino Sports! We know many of you have been eagerly awaiting details, and we're thrilled to share that the game will feature multiplayer mode for up to 4 players in local mode!
Get ready to:
Play as Mazu, Rocky, Bill, and Tiny in a series of eight chomp-sized games.
Fly across deserts, race across glaciers, and blast targets with berries in a variety of fun-filled challenges.
Create your own tournaments, take on AI opponents, or gather your friends for an epic split-screen party!
Will you earn the most medals and claim the Super Giganto Pineapple? Find out in Gigantosaurus: Dino Sports!

[previewyoutube=h-unfelfqkI;full][/previewyoutube]

Out June 28th!
